# RinkPulse

> RinkPulse is a Garmin Connect IQ watch app for hockey tracking, with an Android companion for session history and bigger-screen review.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/): overview of RinkPulse, tracked hockey metrics, supported workflows, Garmin download link, Android beta signup with required tester fields, and FAQ.
- [Support](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/support.html): help for installing the Garmin watch app, editing score/stats in Android, shift detection questions, Android beta access, bug reports, and feature requests.
- [User Guide](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/guide.html): explains how to start a RinkPulse watch workout, navigate watch pages, read shifts, speed, distance, goalie stats, edit score/stats in Android, and sync completed RinkPulse sessions to Android.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/privacy-policy.html): explains local Android storage, optional cloud saves, Garmin watch-session import data, score/stat edits, feedback emails, and what RinkPulse does not collect.
- [Data Deletion](https://rinkpulsehockey.com/data-deletion.html): explains how to delete RinkPulse cloud account data in the Android app or request deletion by email.

## App Links

- [Garmin Connect IQ listing](https://apps.garmin.com/en-US/apps/036b4e61-03af-4946-bc52-89ec13ca7724): public RinkPulse Garmin watch app listing.

## Product Facts

- RinkPulse tracks hockey sessions on Garmin watches.
- Metrics include shifts, ice time, bench time, work/rest, heart-rate zones, and goalie stats.
- Automatic shift detection uses motion, speed/distance evidence when available, short heart-rate context, and gyroscope-backed ice/bench confidence on supported watches.
- The watch app works standalone for post-game stats.
- The Android companion is for local session history, chart review, and skater score/stat edits.
- Skater goals, assists, plus/minus, team score, opponent score, and notes are edited in RinkPulse Companion after manual entry or Garmin import, not on the watch during play.
- Goalie mode still supports save and goal-against entry from the watch.
- Deleting an individual Android session requires confirmation; if cloud sync is enabled, the app queues that session delete for cloud history too.
- RinkPulse Companion can optionally sync session history after sign-in.
- Android import works through completed RinkPulse watch-session summaries sent via Garmin Connect Mobile and the Connect IQ phone connection.
- Android import is not Garmin account cloud sync and does not pull a user's full Garmin account history.
- Imported sessions can include read-only shift-detection diagnostics such as detector version, high-rate accel/gyro status, ice/bench confidence, merge/filter/cap counters, and HR-only expiry counts.
- Users should update both the Garmin watch app and Android companion before troubleshooting sync or missing history. They should not uninstall or clear Android app storage before contacting support.
- RinkPulse Companion can export a user-initiated support diagnostics report with app, phone, Garmin sync, watch-version, visible-history, backup-count, recent-session, and recent-event details.
- Android beta testers should send their Google Play email, Garmin watch model, Android phone model, and what kind of skate they can test.
- The Garmin watch app and local Android history do not require an account. Optional Android cloud saves use a RinkPulse Companion sign-in.
- RinkPulse does not currently provide an iPhone app, Apple Watch app, or Garmin account history import.
- Public support email is currently rinkpulsesupport@gmail.com.
